# aim

`gamepad::unstable::controller::aim` groups deterministic gamepad aiming primitives, including `aim_processor`, `aim_calibration`, `aim_graph`, `turn_integrator`, `low_pass`, deadzone transforms, response curves, and dimension-safe aim types.

## Contents

### Processing

- [assist.cpp](./assist.cpp) implements `aim_processor::process`, `slowdown_scale`, `scale_dominant_axis`, and `lock_on`.
- [assist.hpp](./assist.hpp) declares `aim_processor`, `aim_frame_input`, `aim_frame_output`, `aim_profile`, `lock_on_target`, and `lock_on_params`.
- [integrator.cpp](./integrator.cpp) implements `turn_integrator::advance`.
- [integrator.hpp](./integrator.hpp) declares acceleration/deceleration limits, `advance`, `current`, and `reset`.
- [filter.cpp](./filter.cpp) implements frame-time-independent `low_pass` smoothing.
- [filter.hpp](./filter.hpp) declares `low_pass`, `apply`, `reset`, and `value`.

### Calibration and shaping

- [calibration.cpp](./calibration.cpp) implements `fov_scale`, validated `aim_calibration::make`, and `processor_config`.
- [calibration.hpp](./calibration.hpp) declares `aim_settings`, `aim_calibration`, and FOV-aware calibration ownership.
- [curve.cpp](./curve.cpp) implements `to_string`, `validate`, and `evaluate` for response curves.
- [curve.hpp](./curve.hpp) declares `curve_kind` and `response_curve`.
- [deadzone.cpp](./deadzone.cpp) implements radial `validate` and `apply` for stick deadzones.
- [deadzone.hpp](./deadzone.hpp) declares `deadzone_params`, deadzone validation, and radial transformation.
- [graph.cpp](./graph.cpp) implements validated piecewise-linear `aim_graph::make` and `aim_graph::evaluate`.
- [graph.hpp](./graph.hpp) declares `knot`, `max_graph_knots`, and allocation-free `aim_graph`.

### Domain types

- [types.cpp](./types.cpp) implements stream formatting for `degrees` and `deg_per_s`.
- [types.hpp](./types.hpp) declares `degrees`, `radians`, `deg_per_s`, `deg_per_s2`, `axis_input`, `magnitude`, `screen_vector`, `world_vector`, `dot`, and unit conversions.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`aim_calibration::make` validates `aim_settings`, optionally constructs `aim_graph`, and returns `aim_calibration`; `aim_calibration::processor_config` supplies `aim_processor::config`.

`aim_processor::process` clamps `ads_lerp`, interpolates `aim_profile` values, applies `deadzone_params`, evaluates `response_curve` or `aim_graph`, scales by FOV/sensitivity/slowdown, advances `turn_integrator`, enforces optional limits, and applies pitch inversion.

`low_pass` smooths scalar input independently of frame rate, while `lock_on` converts projected relative velocity into yaw and pitch corrections.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `curve::validate` requires power `exponent` to be finite and greater than `0.0f`; `curve::evaluate` clamps input to `[0.0f, 1.0f]`.
- `deadzone::validate` requires `inner.value`, `outer.value`, and `anti.value` in `[0, 1)`, plus `inner.value < 1.0f - outer.value`.
- `aim_graph::make` accepts 2–`max_graph_knots` knots, with `max_graph_knots == 16`, finite values, inputs in `[0, 1]`, and strictly increasing inputs.
- `aim_processor::process` uses `cfg_.ads.curve` when `t >= 0.5f`, integrates non-negative target speeds before restoring signs, and negates final pitch when `invert_pitch` is true.
- `slowdown_scale` returns `1.0f` without a target and otherwise interpolates hip/ADS scales using clamped `ads_lerp`.
- `scale_dominant_axis` preserves the dominant stick axis and attenuates the subordinate axis by the absolute-magnitude difference.
- `lock_on` returns `{}` when `target.distance <= 0.0f`; otherwise it uses `arc = target.distance * pi`.
- `low_pass::apply` bypasses smoothing when `tau_ <= 0`, adopts the first target exactly, and otherwise uses `alpha = clamp(1 - exp(-dt/tau), 0, 1)`.
- `turn_integrator::advance` returns `degrees{0.0f}` for `dt <= 0` and integrates rate with `0.5f * (prev + cur) * dt`.
- `fov_scale` returns `1.0f` when the reference tangent is non-positive or `f` is non-finite.
- `aim_calibration::make` emits `"hip deadzone: "`, `"ADS deadzone: "`, `"hip curve: "`, `"ADS curve: "`, and `"aim graph: "` diagnostics.

## File Relationships

`assist.cpp` consumes `deadzone.cpp`, `curve.cpp`, `graph.cpp`, and `integrator.cpp` through `assist.hpp`, while `calibration.cpp` assembles `curve`, `deadzone`, and `graph` validation into `aim_processor::config`.

`types.hpp` supplies unit-safe values for `assist.hpp`, `calibration.hpp`, `filter.hpp`, and `integrator.hpp`; `clock.hpp`, `support/types.hpp`, `support/utility.hpp`, and `sample/axis.hpp` supply shared timing and controller primitives.

`aim_calibration::graph_` must outlive processors created from `processor_config()`, and `lock_on_target::view_yaw_axis` must use RIGHT (`+yaw`) coordinates.
